name: nz-employee-share-schemes
description: Use this skill for New Zealand employee share schemes (ESS) run through payroll from 1 April 2026: when an ESS benefit arises and its value, the taxing date, 2026 deferred shares, withholding PAYE and student loans on ESS income, employer funding of the tax, filing and payment dates, and the conditions for an exempt employee share scheme (purchase, value and participation limits, financing, hardship, restrictions and exit, employer deductions and annual disclosure, IR1211 and IR1212). Trigger on ESS, employee share scheme, share options, exempt ESS, IR1211, IR1212. PAYE generally is in nz-employer-payroll.
